text: Bonsai Robotics - About the company Bonsai Robotics is a series A company based in San Jose (United States), founded in 2022 by Tyler Niday. It operates as a Provider of AI-based orchard farm automation solutions. Bonsai Robotics has raised $28.5M in funding from Acre Venture Partners and Bison Ventures. The company has 364 active competitors, including 70 funded and 19 that have exited. Its top competitors include companies like Niqo Robotics, SwarmFarm Robotics and VERDANT ROBOTICS.
